jobs.title: Video research · Tiktok
jobs.research_instructions: VIDEO TOPIC DEEP DIVE (automatic standard web research): read the complete transcript file named in the job. First identify the video's central topic, thesis, material assertions and uncertainties. Then perform a broad, source-led investigation of that topic: current evidence, historical and industry context, competing explanations, second-order implications, risks, scenarios and open questions. Fact-check the video's material assertions in a dedicated section, but do not reduce the report to a claim checklist: the primary output is a durable deep dive. Use normal web research with the Evidence Gate; never claim the proprietary ChatGPT Deep Research mode.
